shortDescription: China has appointed new party chiefs for three provinces including Anhui, Henan and Fujian, Xinhua reported on Wednesday.Li Lecheng was named party secretary for eastern Anhui province, Zhou Zuyi for central Henan, and Zhao Long for southeastern Fujian, the state news agency said.

children: China has appointed new party chiefs for three provinces including Anhui, Henan and Fujian, Xinhua reported on Wednesday.
Li Lecheng was named party secretary for eastern Anhui province, Zhou Zuyi for central Henan, and Zhao Long for southeastern Fujian, the state news agency said.
